entities.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum is a museum in Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, in central Hiroshima, Japan, dedicated to documenting the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in World War II.
